intuition: Water above a bar is limited by the shorter of the tallest walls on its left and right.

brute_force.approach: For each index, scan both sides for their maximum heights and add the trapped depth.

optimal.approach: Move inward from both ends while tracking the maximum wall seen on each side; the shorter side determines safe water.

edge_cases: Fewer than three bars trap no water.
A monotone height profile traps no water.
